text:
leo: hey team — quick new-hire nav q: where do folks usually post calendar room requests and lunch RSVP stuff? also i keep getting bot noise overnight, how can i quiet that but still get critical alerts? :wave:

lena: welcome @leo! calendar room requests -> #office-admin (they manage rooms and AV). lunch RSVPs -> #lunch-plans or your team's channel if it's a small group.

leo: awesome. which channels are read-only vs discussion so i don't accidentally reply in the wrong place?

lena: read-only: #product-announce, #legal-updates, #security-ops (most announcements). Discussion: team channels (e.g., #eng-platform), #devex for tooling, and #random for casual chat. If in doubt, check the channel topic — we put short rules there.

it-support: For bot noise: you can mute per-channel or set quiet hours. Example commands: `/dnd snooze until 07:00` or in a channel use Channel Settings -> Notifications -> "Only @mentions". Some bots support `@ops-bot quiet set window=22:00-07:00` for repo-level quiet hours.

leo: cool — how do I enable only high-severity deploy alerts from @ops-bot for my service?

ops-bot: To subscribe: in #release-notifs run `@ops-bot subscribe service=payments severity>=warning`. To view your subscriptions: `@ops-bot list subs`. Critical oncall alerts (P0) will still be delivered regardless of quiet hours.

leo: perfect. one last thing: where do I post an internal doc draft so the UX folks can review without it becoming public?

lena: create a private channel (e.g., #ux-review-leo) and invite reviewers, or use a gated Google doc and post the link in that private channel. If you need broader feedback later, post a short summary in the team channel with a link.

julie: People Ops note: post onboarding checklist updates as replies in #new-hires so we can mark completion. For reimbursements, attach receipts and include `Reimburse: <amount>` in the thread.

leo: great, posting checklist now and will create a private review channel for the doc. thanks! :tada:

onboard-bot: Thanks @leo — checklist received. People Ops will review and reply in-thread within 24 hours if anything's missing.
